description: Persist completed Rewrite operations in a local SQLite store so operators can audit what the scenario actually changed. Read-only API on the audit trail; no replay capability in v1.

requirements.description: Persist all completed Rewrite apply operations in a local SQLite database. Each audit record must capture: operation ID, plan_id, timestamp, scenario_path, list of operations (serialized), outcome (success/partial/failed), and any error messages. Expose a read-only Connect-RPC API for querying the audit trail. No replay, rollback, or mutation of persisted records is supported in v1. The SQLite store must be initialized automatically on first use with schema migrations versioned.
requirements.title: Rewrite Operation Log Persistence in SQLite

validation.notes: Test that a completed Apply operation writes a record with all required fields to SQLite
Test that SQLite schema migration runs idempotently on an existing database
Test that the read-only API returns records filtered by scenario_path correctly
Test that a failed Apply operation records the error message in the audit trail
TCG-AUDIT-LOG: Run a Rewrite apply operation and verify the record appears in the SQLite audit trail via the read-only API
Restart the Go API process and verify audit records from previous session are still queryable
Verify no write/delete/update endpoints exist on the audit trail API
An operator can audit which files were moved and when, without relying on git history
Audit trail is queryable by scenario_path to review all rewrites applied to a given project

title: Operation Log Persistence
